A New Stage: Trudge through a slowing swamp teeming with insects, spirits, and ancient walking trees. Time is not your enemy here – survival is. Victory lies not in the grains in the hourglass, but in the piles of slain foes.

notes.title: A HoT Teaser of Bards and Bogs
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Adventurers![/b][/h1][p]We took the past months to test new waters, plan ahead, and do some experimentation for Halls of Torment. Now that the path is clear and the development is in full swing, we’d like to give you an update about where we are and what is coming.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Free Update - Bardcore[/b][/h2][p]While working on the release of Halls of Torment, we’ve had a vision for a character that should be part of the base game. But back then the workload was simply too high and we decided to add this specific character in a later update. Since then, we’ve continued our work and we’ll soon be ready to release the character with six unique abilities and some additional content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLr6ez3xV4y_ykp7unhaE9ZM_VGkFPXs3PuTarHJrKK1wni9xPNPq3AUbfn8oLB4OnHieKeEvpl1j4mqTFwMpkb_HepMfrqcnVgTfPMhzzGhsvw1wzeO3KcKPPslHomEqSRLYw?key=jbIHUOkFeHQHzmtzOC5HKA"][/img][/p][p]We’ll share more details about this in a later post. We’ve always wanted this character to be a special reward for beating the game (i.e. beating the Lord of Greed in the Vault), and they will finally arrive in a free update later this year![/p][p]

[/p][h2][b]First DLC - Boglands[/b][/h2][p]Our initial idea of Halls of Torment as a self-contained and rounded experience was very clear and we  hadn’t put much thought beyond this point. But due to the positive reception and because we’re still full of ideas, we decided to release additional content packages. The first of which will contain a new stage, the Boglands, and two new characters. We’re going to release this as a paid DLC alongside the above-mentioned big free update later this year.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeeOJjvE8vBbHRyxQhkVN7UEQvg-jgw7y_xxJxnQK02Ye7yGC4cr68OXlSJax4__Ekd9rt9ElxzjxzmyCsu085kO9map7QZGXMzio-NJwAK2KsDjTWgDgLVkec58QRWT5XSumB85A?key=jbIHUOkFeHQHzmtzOC5HKA"][/img][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdrNXwNBWV3kpFY9b6OqoXoE-qdLKazWaBmfx4R5MZoWAkk9K_XwFYymCmnj-PH85w5PrkkZ59SEEi9Z7GZBtxC1ZqC_0nxiica9lyCZ8Tq8mrIEQOOjC1S7rEhQJGdyZTMBJXGcg?key=jbIHUOkFeHQHzmtzOC5HKA"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Console Versions[/b][/h2][p]As teased several times before, we are working on console versions of Halls of Torment. It’s finally confirmed to be a thing and we are aiming to bring the game to Xbox and Playstation within this year.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p]We’d like to thank you for staying with us and enjoying the game. We are reading your feedback and reports and considering them for our next release. Hopefully we can deliver more insights in the coming weeks.
[/p][p][b]That’s it for now - more will follow soon enough.[/b][/p][p] [b]- Chasing Carrots[/b][/p]

- Lord of Greed would not take damage from projectiles.
- Scriptor could not be rescued by using projectiles.
- Demonic Grasp (Rare) variation wasn't working.
- Master's Vice would increase base HP by 1 instead of reducing it.
- Increased the Champion spawn rate in Vault after 30 minutes.

Stay Fresh!
- Chasing Carrots

notes.title: HoT Update & Supporter Pack DLC
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Adventurers![/h1]

We have an array of news for you today. First of all, we’d like to thank you for the feedback regarding our newest update. It helped us improve the experience, find issues and fix them.
Besides the already mentioned new update, we have a whole package of additional little things for you:

[list]
[*] Free Update with new items, artifacts, balancing adjustments and QoL features
[*] Supporter Pack DLC & Original Soundtrack in a bundle with the main game
[*] New community items such as animated backgrounds and profile images in the Steam Points Shop
[*] Adding Vietnamese and Traditional Chinese localization to the game
[/list]

This update marks the beginning of the post-1.0 updates. We intend to bring more and bigger updates later this year. They will consist of two parts: the first being free updates that introduce smaller features and improvements, the second being bigger paid DLCs containing new maps, characters, abilities, and features. Stay tuned for more updates!

[h2]Free Update[/h2]
[b]Available for everyone from now on![/b]
[list]
[*] Added the possibility to upgrade abilities a 3rd time (Sage with Sage Mark and Signets).
[*] Added a total of 4 new item types.
[*] 6 new artifacts to mix up your gameplay.
[*] Balanced the game to enable more playstyles on higher torment levels.
[*] QoL: DPS-meter, pickup range indicator, VSync option, more character stats.
[*] A few dozen bug fixes.
[*] Stability and performance fixes and changes.
[*] Full patch notes: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2218750/discussions/0/758394165818106534/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2218750/discussions/0/758394165818106534/[/url]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/ff573516d7ed54662c0730f15f6cc0beabe8ccc9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/03e0e3b623db6f308f7917b1cf4ebb1a7354486a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/3720aa75512ebf3e5347acab6f4bb609f8b5569e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/6938ebf1db26aa98b2aea5c71386aaa670013118.png[/img]


[h2]Supporter Bundle[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49776/Tormented_Supporter/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49776/Tormented_Supporter/[/url]

[b]Will contain the Supporter Pack DLC and the Original Sound Track:[/b]
[list]
[*] The soundtrack contains 8 songs with a playtime of 49 minutes in total and will be updated with tracks that will be added in the future.
[*] The Supporter Pack will contain only cosmetics and the Training Grounds area. It won’t give any actual advantage in the game.
[*] Alternative character skins for each of the 1.0 characters.
[*] Three additional HUD themes.
[*] The Training Grounds area to test specific builds and setups.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/1d15567829f4b08ce2cec5adcbeaa7a6cba4e722.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/cab310dc7529a4f71bf58292739c1a895320228e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/f0edbfe54072e2dfeca6a5b8b1423c82669ce45c.png[/img]


[h2]Community Items available in the Steam Points Shop[/h2]
[list]
[*] Animated profile background (normal & mini version).
[*] Three animated avatar frames.
[*] Three animated avatars.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/a8e882ed538c5d1e0584c6a700c536af9606a869.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/3d35167a4c6c7d556d1f1fa0181abc64da58948c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/97181d5b8ddf99913dc5cd5c04ef4f1410d08944.png[/img]


We are grateful for such an incredible community that has made Halls of Torment possible and we’ll share details for more content soon. In the meantime you can see our current progress, including the new content (potential spoilers!) on our public Codecks page:
[url=https://open.codecks.io/hot]Codecks – Halls of Torment 1.0[/url]

[h3]Stay Fresh
- Chasing Carrots[/h3]

notes.title: HoT Experimental Update | 2025-01-21
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2]

In roughly 2-3 weeks we intend to release our first proper post-release update with the Supporter Pack and Original Soundtrack. The Store pages for both will be coming online within the next few days, but the accompanying free update will be available today on the “Experimental” branch.

If you are new here, we usually update our content on the Experimental branch early to gather some feedback and do readjustments before the release on the main branch. If you want to join the Experimental branch, right-click on Halls of Torment in your Steam library, select “Properties…”, go to “Betas”, and set the beta branch to “Experimental”.

[b]The full change log with a feedback collection thread can be found here:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2218750/discussions/0/758394165818106534/


[h3]An overview of the changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pickup Range / DPS Meter options.
[*] 4 new items.
[*] 6 new artifacts.
[*] Balanced Shrine of Torment. (values and artifacts)
[*] Introduced ways to upgrade abilities 3 times per run.
[*] Balanced Block/Defense of players and Damage of enemies.
[*] Adjusted monster spawns, generally a bit lower but tougher monsters.
[*] Performance / Stability updates.
[*] Several smaller balancing adjustments especially to projectile based abilities.
[*] Dozens of bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Stay Fresh!
- Chasing Carrots[/b]

notes.title: HoT Preview | Update 01 & Supporter Pack
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Fellow Tormented Souls![/h1]

We hope you all are doing well so far. As for us, we’re happily working on things to come and making plans further down the road. As previously announced after the last update, we decided to take it a bit slower. The next update will take until early next year, probably late January or February, mostly because we’re going to take a little break during the festive season.

But still, we have some progress to share with you. This is a quick preview of things to come.
We’re currently working on two things in parallel. The first one is a smaller free update with some new items and artifacts. Balancing, bug fixes, and performance improvements are coming as well. Further below you’ll find a small excerpt. If you’re interested in the full list, you can find it here: [url=https://open.codecks.io/hot]https://open.codecks.io/hot[/url]

The second part will be a paid DLC: the Supporter Pack. It will contain mostly visual changes to heroes and the in-game HUD, and also a small training area to test out some of your favorite builds in a controlled environment.

In 2025 we will keep working on Halls of Torment. Besides working on console support for Halls of Torment we’re also planning to work on content DLCs that will bring new stages, characters, and abilities. But more about that next year.


[h2]Free Update 01 [/h2]
Six new artifacts for additional challenges, including a smaller rebalancing of the Torment Levels.
Torment Levels will have a reduced increase in Damage and Movement Speed for enemies.
[list]
[*] New Artifact: Enemies will gain Block Strength with each player level.
[*] New Artifact: Reduce elemental chances but increase elemental damage.
[*] New Artifact: Make enemies bigger, fewer of them spawn but they have more health.
[*] New Artifact: Chance for each regular enemy to spawn as an enhanced version, dropping goodies.
[*] New Artifact: Reduce the maximum number of abilities.
[*] New Artifact: Reduce crit and effect chance with bigger area and range.
[/list]

There are also four new items coming. One will be a bit special as it will not have a common version. You’ll only ever get the uncommon version of it.
[list]
[*] Elemental Capacitor (Necklace): Apply Damage bonus to Burn, Spark and Frost.
[*] Beast Master’s Hide (Body): Spawns beasts fighting for you. They despawn once they’ve taken too much damage.
[*] Demonic Grasp (Footwear): When moving spawn summoned hands that grab enemies, XP, and items.
[*] Ability Signet (Ring): Enables the wearer to upgrade an ability three times. (can’t be unequipped)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/37ede6c10851ba255e9941632f671c9113dff9fb.png[/img]

With the Ability Signet we also updated the Sage’s Mark that upon equipping it with the sage it allows the sage to use the 3rd upgrade of an ability on his main ability.

[b]Other changes coming:[/b]
[list]
[*] Many smaller technical performance improvements.
[*] Changing the spawn pattern of waves to reduce lag spikes.
[*] Additional information in the character stats about things like burn, spark and frost damage.
[*] Shrine of Archeologists will now be teleported to the player like the well after defeating a lord.
[*] An option to make the pickup range visible.
[*] Vsync On/Off option to enable higher FPS.
[*] Vault will spawn champions after 30 minutes.
[*] Live DPS overlay.
[*] Some additional things we’re still working on!
[/list]


[h2]Supporter DLC[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’ll add an alternative cosmetic skin for each character.
[/list]Those are purely visual and do not change the gameplay of characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/1d96391290f47a5a8f2397f07b10f91d42170509.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Three HUD designs that can be selected via the settings.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/f55de19ccb2bc5dd7eec8f5734fa4d2a026a7d1c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] A training area to test setups in a controlled environment.
[/list]


We also want to say a big thank you for all the support the community has shown. Your feedback is always very helpful for us! We wish you all a good end of the year 2024! See you soon!
[b]- Chasing Carrots[/b]

notes.title: HoT Patch | 2024-10-10
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurers![/h1]

After having the latest patch tested on the Experimental branch we just made it available for everyone. We'd like to thank players active on the branch and giving us feedback and reporting bugs. We made some additional changed including some new Bug Fixes.



[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Compendium QoL:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every hero now has their own Torment Shard pool.
[*] Holding the button to spend a shard will continuously increase them.
[*] Right-Click removes shards from a single stat.
[*] Collecting one Torment Shard will increase the shards for all characters.
[*] The amount of used Torment Shards can now be seen in the end screen.
[/list]

[h3]Torment Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Agony will add 1 Defense to each enemy per rank.
[*] Changing the scaling of Torment Levels and the Vault past 30 minutes.
[*] Health will be changed to scale x1.12 instead of x1.2.
[*] Defense scaling will be added with x1.12.
[*] In Vault the Torment Levels will add 0.33 base defense to enemies each level.
[*] Damage scaling will be changed from +4% to +5% per level.
[/list]

[h3]Blood Catcher:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scaling of the Max. HP effect will be limited from 100 3 000.
[*] Blood Catcher gains proper Diminishing Returns application.
[*] Blood Catcher has been changed back to only give a modifier bonus when the player is on full health.
[*] Blood Catcher now triggers every 5 seconds and applies its effect then based on the damage within that time frame.
[/list]

[h3]Further Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the Quest Board, one can now always see the required character for the next main quest/tracked quest on the top.
[*] Turning off flash intensity also deactivates the flashes when the player is hit by enemies.
[*] Hailstorm can now handle negative movement speed.
[*] Astronomer’s Orbs can now over-crit.
[*] Adding the current Game Version to the End Screen.
[*] The targeting range of Summons now adjust with their attack range.
[*] Beast Huntress' Dedication was adjusted so that the base range does not scale so much, making it more likely for the Hound to attack more enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Widescreen Pillar Box setting was not saved when leaving the game.
[*] Fixed the Artifacts "Restless Wheel" not accelerating Agony increase.
[*] Hunter’s Garb (Hawk Eye) is now modifying the Crit values.
[*] Hunter’s Garb variants now show the info Icon on the right side of the screen.
[*] Phantom Needles traits gave Crit Chance instead of Base Crit Chance.
[*] Archer’s Dedication was unlocked by the wrong Trait.
[*] Spectral Fists would not react to Attack Speed upgrades for melee/summon modifiers when Consecutive Punches had been activated.
[*] Values of uncommon and rare Plated Boots had been mixed up.
[*] Fixed an issue were the Cyclops from the Ember Eye would trigger Artifact quests to be completed.
[*] Quest “Tank I” had a wrong number in its description.
[*] Rank frame of Norseman's WP IV (Storming) was wrong.
[*] End screen congratulation text was sometimes truncated.
[*] Compendium did not update used Torment Shards in the info area.
[*] Scars of Toil had the wrong tooltip on its Icon.
[*] Warlocks character description said he should have only 350 instead of 500 HP.
[*] Cleric was stronger than their information made appear. (regeneration, Defense and Block Strength)
[/list]


[b]Thank you for everything!
- Chasing Carrots[/b]

notes.title: HoT Experimental Update | 2024-10-08
notes.content:
Update 2024-10-10

Latest changes:
- Movement Speed per Torment Level has been changed back from 2.5% to 2.0%
- Blood Catcher bonus has been slightly reduced, but heal was increased on higher rarities.
- Polishing the shard display in the End Screen.
- Adding the current Game Version to the End Screen.
- Fixed the Artifacts "Restless Wheel" not accelerating Agony increase.
- Fixed an issue were the Cyclops from the Ember Eye would trigger Artifact quests to be completed.
- Fixed Plated Boots (Boost), uncommon and rare values were swapped.
- The targeting range of Summons now adjust with their attack range.
- Beast Huntress' Dedication was adjusted so that the base range does not scale so much, making it more likely for the Hound to attack more enemies.

-----------------


[h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2]

We are working through your reports and feedback and today we are going to implement a few required changes on the experimental branch for testing them out. Please let us know what you think.
If you would like to join testing the coming changes, please change in the game properties -> betas the testing branch to “experimental”.

[url=https://open.codecks.io/hot]Codecks – Halls of Torment 1.0[/url]
[b]Experimental Update: 2024-10-08
Scheduled Release: 2024-10-10[/b]


[h3]Torment Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Agony will add 1 Defense to each enemy per rank.
[*] Changing the scaling of Torment Levels and the Vault past 30 minutes.
[*] Health will be changed to scale x1.12 instead of x1.2.
[*] Defense scaling will be added with x1.12.
[*] In Vault the Torment Levels will add 0.33 base defense to enemies each level.
[*] Damage scaling will be changed from +4% to +5% per level.
[*] Movement Speed scaling will be changed from +2% to +2.5% per level.
[/list]
We’ve decided on this change for two reasons. One is that now and probably in the future, items and effects that scale with damage do scale much stronger with the big HP pools. Secondly some enemies were approaching and hit the highest HP possible in the game, causing bugs. With this change we can easily go up to Torment Level 40+ and the Vault is quite some time longer after the current 95 minutes after which it starts breaking.


[h3]Blood Catcher:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scaling of the Max. HP effect will be limited from 100 - 3 000.
[*] Blood Catcher gains proper Diminishing Returns application.
[*] Blood Catcher has been changed back to only give a modifier bonus when the player is on full health.
[*] Blood Catcher now triggers every 5 seconds and applies its effect then based on the damage within that time frame.
[/list]
In the 1.0 patch we changed that Blood Catcher has been always applying its buff, even if the player was damaged. We changed this back but also applied the normal Diminishing Returns mechanic from other items in the game. The limitation of the scaling based on one's Max. HP has been introduced because the Blood Catcher had many Edge Case scenarios with almost no HP. These changes have been made to bring the Blood Catcher down to a level of other items, the Blood Catcher was so much stronger that making “everything else stronger” was not an option without entirely breaking the game’s balance.
Lastly the 5 second refresh has been added to avoid lag because of multiple modifier updates and heal events per second/frame from the item. The modifier strength is not influenced by this change.


[h3]Further Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] In the Quest Board, one can now always see the required character for the next main quest/tracked quest on the top.
[*] Every hero now has their own Torment Shard pool.
[*] Collecting one Torment Shard will increase the shards for all characters.
[*] The amount of used Torment Shards can now be seen in the end screen.
[*] Turning off flash intensity also deactivates the flashes when the player is hit by enemies.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Widescreen Pillarbox setting was not saved when leaving the game.
[*] Hailstorm can now handle negative movement speed.
[*] Astronomer’s Orbs can now overcrit.
[*] Hunter’s Garb (Hawk Eye) is now modifying the Crit values.
[*] Hunter’s Garb variants now show the info Icon on the right side of the screen.
[*] Phantom Needles traits gave Crit Chance instead of Base Crit Chance.
[*] Archer’s Dedication was unlocked by the wrong Trait.
[*] Spectral Fists would not react to Attack Speed upgrades for melee/summon modifiers when Consecutive Punches had been activated.
[*] Values of uncommon and rare Plated Boots (Growth) had been mixed up.
[*] Quest “Tank I” had a wrong number in its description.
[*] Rank frame of Norsemans WP IV (Storming) was wrong.
[*] Endscreen congratulation text was sometimes truncated.
[*] Compendium did not update used Torment Shards in the info area.
[*] Scars of Toil had the wrong tooltip on its Icon.
[*] Warlocks character description said he should have only 350 instead of 500 HP.
[*] Cleric was stronger than their information made appear. (regeneration, Defense and Block Strength)
[/list]

[h3]Stay Hydrated
- Chasing Carrots[/h3]

notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We just fixed the first batch of bugs.
To make sure you get the latest update restart Steam (Or on Steam Deck leave the game and turn it off/on)

Thanks for your support, we'll keep an eye open for further reports and feedback over the coming days and weeks.

Stay Fresh

notes.title: HoT 1.0 | Final Stage & End Game
notes.content:
[h1]Good Day Adventurer![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/b8d94b998bbf66b564e2eed3a7a62a2835d16dac.gif[/img]

It has been a long journey, but we’ve finally arrived at our destination. The path to the last hall will be revealed and its demons, monsters, and the magic will break loose. Never-ending torrents of fiends will overwhelm even the most cunning adventurers and new challenges will make even the bravest champion shiver. Are you ready to take on the quest for unreachable treasures, endless power, and the most rare artifacts out there?

Welcome to Halls of Torment 1.0! The past 17 months have been quite an adventure for us. We’ve tried out many things that will vanish from the books of history forever, but probably not from the guide section. But now we’re here, thanks to you all. We’ve extended the originally planned 6 month Early Access and now we are (almost) satisfied with what came out of it. We don’t know exactly how to proceed next with the Halls, but we know that we want to keep new and smaller updates coming and maybe even add some additional features. We’ll keep our communication channels open and we want to continue adjusting and improving the game based on your feedback.

To add transparency to our communication we decided to have an open version of our management tool available for everyone to take a look into. It's been cleaned and reports and feedback after 1.0 launch will be added there: [url=https://open.codecks.io/hot]https://open.codecks.io/hot[/url]
Reports can be given as usual through the Steam Forums and our Discord server.



[h2]Changelog 1.0[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43496740/67201b9fa3d7e3e9199da1436518721c027f5214.gif[/img]

[h3]💰 THE VAULT[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Vault is the final stage of Halls of Torment and can be unlocked by purchasing 30 items from the Wellkeeper.
[*] To enter the vault you’ll need to spend some coins. The price is (mostly) up to you.
[*] The more you pay the more modifiers are added to the Vault. They may be positive, negative, or… ambiguous.
[*] Every 4th modifier adds a Torment Shard to the final drop.
[*] The Vault lord does not spawn automatically after 30 minutes but requires you to activate him.
[*] A Vault run lasts for as long as the lord is alive.
[*] After the 30 minute mark the monsters' strength continuously rises.
[*] Beating the Vault unlocks the post game. This currently includes making uncommon items recoverable and being able to find additional artifacts. 🪙
[*] The Vault has a medium sized quest board to complete.
[/list]


[h3]💀 THE SHRINE OF TORMENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlocks by defeating the first boss in the Chambers of Dissonance.
[*] Agony mode will be moved to the Shrine of Torment entirely.
[*] Defeating lords in Agony now grants Artifact drops.
[*] Artifacts can be used to customize the game mode, but they also increase stats of monsters.
[*] There are a total of 30 artifacts (for now) of which you can use as many as you want.
[*] Using more artifacts improves drop chances, rarity of loot, and amount of champions.
[*] Additional artifacts unlock when you defeat the Lord in the Vault.
[*] If someone manages to defeat the Shrine with all artifacts we’ll simply keep adding. 👿
[*] An artifact quest board has been added to test the mastery of each and single one of them.
[*] Additional quests that require the usage of artifacts have been added across all boards.
[/list]


[h3]📜 THE SCRIPTOR[/h3]
[list]
[*] He must be rescued from the Frozen Depths. (bring some fire 🔥)
[*] The Scriptor kindly informs you about all recoverable items available in Halls of Torment.
[*] Also, you may have already collected some Torment Shards.
[*] The Scriptor can permanently improve characters with shards. (fully refundable!)
[*] In the future the Scriptor may hold additional information.
[*] The scriptor has something to say about the other NPCs in the camp (and vice versa).
[/list]


[h3]⚔️ CHARACTERS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Trait V quests can now be unlocked!
[*] Each character has 5 rank V traits available. 2 Weapon Proficiencies, 2 Stances and 1 Dedication
[*] The Weapon Proficiency is exclusive to each character.
[*] Stances are trade-offs for major play styles of each character. (Available via Marks)
[*] Dedications are improvements of the play styles of each character. (Available via Marks)
[*] Only one of the V-Rank traits can be taken from each character per run. (unless you do some potion witchery 🍾)
[*] Traits are available at level 60 when the previous traits have been taken.
[*] Each type Weapon Proficiency/Stance/Dedication for each character has an unlock quest.
[*] Sage has seen some changes regarding his balancing.
[*] Minor character balancing for all other characters, but no more drastic changes.
[/list]


[h3]📦ITEMS[/h3]
[list]
[*] All items now have 2 uncommon versions.
[*] Items can now be recovered in the post game. (Beat the Vault!)
[*] When using enough Artifacts, items of a new rarity can be found that are further improved variants.
[*] It’s now more likely to find new items from Boss Chests.
[*] Champions will now drop buckets without you having to send any item through the well first.
[*] Up to two additional buckets can be found per run.
[*] The well will teleport close to the player after defeating the lord of a stage.
[*] There have been no new items added in this patch, but new ones will arrive in the future!
[*] Some items saw changes in functionality, fixes, and improvements.
[*] Jade Amulet now converts collected gold to XP.
[*] Collar of Confidence is no longer capped but has diminishing returns.
[*] Duelist’s Spark now increases damage for the number of defeated champions, bosses, and elites. This count does not reset between runs.
[*] Gatherer’s Amulet variants can refill potions during a run.
[*] Berserker Boots are now uncapped and have diminishing returns.
[*] Elven Boots are now uncapped and have diminishing returns.
[*] Hunter’s Garb is now uncapped and has diminishing returns.
[*] Blood Soaked Shirt is now uncapped and has diminishing returns.
[/list]


[h3]🥕QUESTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve added so many quests, we reached a total count of 500!
[*] There are a lot of new additional milestone quests. They are now spanning two boards.
[*] Existing saves will see that new levels of existing quest types will be automatically set to the level of the previous quest.
[*] Almost all quests are now trackable with the quest tracker instead of just showing 0/1 completed.
[*] Quests that are time based may scale with run time shortening artifacts.
[*] Certain quests have reduced requirements, specialist quests in particular.
[*] The “Main Quests” suggestions have been expanded to cover the whole game until “beating” the game.
[*] Additional information about quest tracking has been added to the game.
[*] All currently available quest boards have been filled up, and they all have been added as achievements.
[*] There might be more quests in the future, but quests after 1.0 will not be added as Steam achievements.
[*] Unfortunately not all final quest icons will be available, they will be added in the near future.
[/list]


[h3]🌍STAGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve added distance information to collectables on the screen edge markers.
[*] All stages got one or more additional ability drops, either by champions or placed directly in the stage.
[*] Additional drops must be unlocked via quests.
[*] On some maps the well has been visually adjusted.
[*] All stages got unique traps and enemies activated by new major Artifacts.
[*] For the base stages we expanded the amount of different champions and also added new abilities to them.
[*] Champion drops have been adjusted to improve when playing with artifacts.
[*] Changed how champions scale. It should happen less often now that they have dramatic damage spikes.
[/list]


[h3]🪄ABILITIES[/h3]
[list]
[*] New unlocks for stages to enable a fixed drop of 11 abilities scrolls/tomes for each stage.
[*] All abilities have gotten an adjustment regarding Crit Chances, Crit Damage, Base Damage and traits that affect those values to line up more with base traits.
[*] Blessings focus now on relative increase rather than absolute ones.
[*] Spectral Fists adaptation traits have been altered to be better understandable, converting Attack Speed and Multistrike to Damage bonus.
[*] Increased the normal attack damage of Spirit Warriors, but changed that the projectile upgrades scale less drastically.
[*] Arcane Rift explosions can now actually apply damage effects.
[*] Reduced effect apply chance of Elemental Rifts when enemies are standing on them.
[*] Changed Arcane Rift spawning to be more regular.
[*] Kugelblitz now spawns more regularly and scales more evenly.
[*] Kugelblitz speed now scales with Movement Speed instead of Range.
[*] Meteor Strike now hits more regularly but with less foreseeable pattern. Increasing Base Area instead.
[*] Fixed an issue on Meteor Strike were triggers would be skipped when certain attack speeds were reached.
[*] Golem Upgrades no longer affect Roll duration or Roll Cooldowns
[*] Golem has a higher base Speed and more lax movement restriction to attack more often.
[*] Golem (and all other Summons) now scale their movement speed with the player!
[*] Golem’s Base Roll Cooldown and Duration have been increased, reducing the time wasted on transition states.
[*] If the Golem has a lower cooldown than Roll Duration, the Golem will no longer stop rolling.
[*] Golem Traits have been adjusted to reflect base balance change. It is also possible to get the Golem to no longer roll.
[*] Dragon’s Breath has now a higher Base Damage, also reflecting this in its traits.
[*] Fixed an issue where the flame turned invisible and kept moving.
[*] Base Attack Speed of Ring Blades has been doubled. In turn they have a 20% lower duration.
[*] Cyclone upgrade has been changed into a pattern to cover more area closer to the player.
[*] Frost Avalanche will not travel for as long as before and will also visually disappear gradually.
[*] Lightning Strikes now deal significantly more damage and have bigger areas and the base spawn is higher.
[*] Lightning Strikes scaling has been reduced a bit, but some negative modifiers have been removed from traits.
[*] Astronomer’s Orbs have been increased to 5, but deal less damage each.
[*] Astronomer’s Orbs had almost all traits rebalanced to reflect the base balance change.
[*] Many traits are losing some or all negative modifiers.
[*] Arcane Splinter now spawn more bullets that have a significantly higher base damage.
[*] Arcane Splinters have a lower duration.
[/list]


[h3]✨QOL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Abilities have now markers to let you know if they can be upgraded.
[*] When leveling up, it’s now more likely to get traits that are related to traits you’ve memorized via Potion of Memories.
[*] Endscreen now shows the active artifacts in a run.
[*] The quest menu now features a row of pips that indicate where you are currently in the quest board navigation.
[*] You can now view character and ability stats from the ability/trait selection.
[*] 16:10 and Widescreen support. When in widescreen mode: We are aware that you will see monsters popping in the middle of the screen. We do not change the gameplay/balancing to accommodate various screen ratios.
[/list]


[h3]💻OTHER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Halls of Torment is now running on Godot 4.3 including all available bug fixes! (Huge thanks to all the Godot contributors and maintainers!)
[*] Tons of stability and performance improvements, the game should run much smoother now. It will still tend to lag in late games or when too many things happen at once, but we are on it to push the limits.
[*] Game statistic tracking in the game profile starting from 1.0, to have the possibility to add statistics views in the future.
[*] Some abilities have been touched to bring them more in line with others, especially some traits related to them.
[*] Five new blessings have been added, three of them related to critical strikes.
[/list]


For this update, we won’t be able to provide a full extensive change log, since most changes happened before we started full documentation. We’ll provide detailed change logs for future updates. Also, early testing will happen in the future again.

Want to help us? Please spread the news!
You’re an awesome community! So as always:

[h3]Stay Fresh
- Chasing Carrots 🥕[/h3]

Some items saw changes in functionality, fixes, and improvements.

tags.balance_change: Jade Amulet now converts collected gold to XP.
Collar of Confidence is no longer capped but has diminishing returns.
Duelist’s Spark now increases damage for the number of defeated champions, bosses, and elites. This count does not reset between runs.
Gatherer’s Amulet variants can refill potions during a run.
Berserker Boots are now uncapped and have diminishing returns.
Elven Boots are now uncapped and have diminishing returns.
Hunter’s Garb is now uncapped and has diminishing returns.
Blood Soaked Shirt is now uncapped and has diminishing returns.

tags.feature: We’ve added so many quests, we reached a total count of 500!
There are a lot of new additional milestone quests. They are now spanning two boards.
Existing saves will see that new levels of existing quest types will be automatically set to the level of the previous quest.
Almost all quests are now trackable with the quest tracker instead of just showing 0/1 completed.
Quests that are time based may scale with run time shortening artifacts.

tags.balance_change: Certain quests have reduced requirements, specialist quests in particular.

tags.feature: The “Main Quests” suggestions have been expanded to cover the whole game until “beating” the game.
Additional information about quest tracking has been added to the game.
All currently available quest boards have been filled up, and they all have been added as achievements.
There might be more quests in the future, but quests after 1.0 will not be added as Steam achievements.
Unfortunately not all final quest icons will be available, they will be added in the near future.
We’ve added distance information to collectables on the screen edge markers.
All stages got one or more additional ability drops, either by champions or placed directly in the stage.
Additional drops must be unlocked via quests.
On some maps the well has been visually adjusted.
All stages got unique traps and enemies activated by new major Artifacts.
For the base stages we expanded the amount of different champions and also added new abilities to them.

tags.balance_change: Champion drops have been adjusted to improve when playing with artifacts.
Changed how champions scale. It should happen less often now that they have dramatic damage spikes.

tags.feature: New unlocks for stages to enable a fixed drop of 11 abilities scrolls/tomes for each stage.

tags.balance_change: All abilities have gotten an adjustment regarding Crit Chances, Crit Damage, Base Damage and traits that affect those values to line up more with base traits.
Blessings focus now on relative increase rather than absolute ones.
Spectral Fists adaptation traits have been altered to be better understandable, converting Attack Speed and Multistrike to Damage bonus.
Increased the normal attack damage of Spirit Warriors, but changed that the projectile upgrades scale less drastically.

tags.bug: Arcane Rift explosions can now actually apply damage effects.

tags.balance_change: Reduced effect apply chance of Elemental Rifts when enemies are standing on them.
Changed Arcane Rift spawning to be more regular.
Kugelblitz now spawns more regularly and scales more evenly.
Kugelblitz speed now scales with Movement Speed instead of Range.
Meteor Strike now hits more regularly but with less foreseeable pattern. Increasing Base Area instead.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue on Meteor Strike were triggers would be skipped when certain attack speeds were reached.

tags.balance_change: Golem Upgrades no longer affect Roll duration or Roll Cooldowns
Golem has a higher base Speed and more lax movement restriction to attack more often.
Golem (and all other Summons) now scale their movement speed with the player!
Golem’s Base Roll Cooldown and Duration have been increased, reducing the time wasted on transition states.
If the Golem has a lower cooldown than Roll Duration, the Golem will no longer stop rolling.
Golem Traits have been adjusted to reflect base balance change. It is also possible to get the Golem to no longer roll.
Dragon’s Breath has now a higher Base Damage, also reflecting this in its traits.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the flame turned invisible and kept moving.

tags.balance_change: Base Attack Speed of Ring Blades has been doubled. In turn they have a 20% lower duration.
Cyclone upgrade has been changed into a pattern to cover more area closer to the player.
Frost Avalanche will not travel for as long as before and will also visually disappear gradually.
Lightning Strikes now deal significantly more damage and have bigger areas and the base spawn is higher.
Lightning Strikes scaling has been reduced a bit, but some negative modifiers have been removed from traits.
Astronomer’s Orbs have been increased to 5, but deal less damage each.
Astronomer’s Orbs had almost all traits rebalanced to reflect the base balance change.
Many traits are losing some or all negative modifiers.
Arcane Splinter now spawn more bullets that have a significantly higher base damage.
Arcane Splinters have a lower duration.

tags.feature: Abilities have now markers to let you know if they can be upgraded.
When leveling up, it’s now more likely to get traits that are related to traits you’ve memorized via Potion of Memories.
Endscreen now shows the active artifacts in a run.
The quest menu now features a row of pips that indicate where you are currently in the quest board navigation.
You can now view character and ability stats from the ability/trait selection.

16:10 and Widescreen support. When in widescreen mode: We are aware that you will see monsters popping in the middle of the screen. We do not change the gameplay/balancing to accommodate various screen ratios.

tags.bug: Halls of Torment is now running on Godot 4.3 including all available bug fixes! (Huge thanks to all the Godot contributors and maintainers!)

tags.feature: Tons of stability and performance improvements, the game should run much smoother now. It will still tend to lag in late games or when too many things happen at once, but we are on it to push the limits.
Game statistic tracking in the game profile starting from 1.0, to have the possibility to add statistics views in the future.

tags.balance_change: Some abilities have been touched to bring them more in line with others, especially some traits related to them.

tags.feature: Five new blessings have been added, three of them related to critical strikes.

notes.title: HoT Release on 24th September
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2]

We are pleased to announce the final date and time for the 1.0 version release! - [b]24th September, 15:00 CEST (Or 9am EST, 6am PST, 1pm UTC, 22:00 JST, 21:00 CST).[/b]..+- a few minutes because of technical struggles we might have ;)

[b]Over 900 0[/b]00 of you have been playing during Early Access, and for that we are very grateful. We were able to make the game better and bigger than we could have wished for thanks to your support and feedback!

But you probably want to know what we are going to add?
Fear not, this will be our [b]biggest update to date for Halls of Torment![/b]

[list]
[*] We will add the final stage in the game: [b]The Vault.[/b] This stage will be a bit special and you might need some coins to enter. The Vault is [b]not limited to thirty minutes[/b] - which means you can take your time or try to get through as fast as you possibly can.
[*] [b]The Scriptor can be rescued from the Frozen Depths[/b]. He just needs someone to lighten him up. If you do, not only will he give you an overview over all the collectable items, he’ll also allow you to [b]continuously improve individual character stats[/b] in exchange for Torment Shards.
[*] Torment Shards? Yes, you probably already have a handful of them lying around. Never wondered about those fancy crystals the lords are dropping? ;)
[*] And why is an item overview helpful? Not necessarily to satisfy greed, but to know all the [b]base items and variants that will be recoverable from the Halls[/b]. Yes, variants, the new Shrine of Torment will enable you to recover ‘uncommon’ tier items.
[*] The Shrine of Torment is something we feel many of you have eagerly waited for. We want to put back the Torment into the Halls and make HoT difficult again! The shrine will allow you to [b]customize the game while increasing the difficulty[/b] so much that we are sure you are going to die, sooner or later.
[*] For that find the [b]30 artifacts[/b] that the lords hold onto in agony mode. Agony mode will be exclusively accessible through the Shrine of Torment in the future. One of those artifacts will be the ‘[b]Hastening Sands’ that cut off 10 minutes[/b] from the regular runtime of a run.
[*] You can activate as many artifacts as you wish. They might spawn additional monsters, set you on fire, reverse your walking direction, or hurt you whenever you collect gold. In return for enduring such torment you may be able to find some [b]new shiny and rare items[/b] that are much stronger than their uncommon counterparts.
[*] We are [b]finishing up the achievements[/b] with a whopping set of 500 quests. There might be more quests in the future, if you want, but these 500 will make up all the achievements on Steam for the future. And naturally they unlock a few new things, such as [b]blessings related to critical hits[/b].
[*] [b]Character traits of the 5th rank[/b]: These traits work a bit differently than other character traits and might have a higher impact. You can take only one of those traits for the chosen character (or character mark).
[*] Those new traits are unlocked by some extra crunchy quests in which you need to prove your worth… or by the amount of uncommon items and meta upgrades collected. To make it easier to track those quests we have rewritten many of the quests to be properly trackable with the quest tracking system!
[*] From 1.0 on you will also have the option to use the full width and height of your screen. For example, [b]when playing with the Steam Deck or on a wide screen[/b]. But be aware, the game experience is optimized for 16:9 and some things might just pop into your screen instead of being magically hidden.
[*] Other than that: polish and quality of life, like [b]distance indicators[/b] showing you how far away the next ability scrolls is, an additional view that [b]shows you character and ability stats during trait/ability selection[/b], unlocking additional ability drops on early stages, and more!
[*] Under the hood we’ve also worked on [b]performance and stability[/b]. We’ve upgraded to [b]Godot 4.3[/b] in time to bring some additional improvements ([b]Huge shoutout to the Godot community improving the engine and also fixing issues![/b]). We hope we could reduce most of the lag, the crashes, and any other type of problem. But we are always on the lookout for more issue reports :)
[/list]

Now you have an idea of what to expect. You want to help us to reach 1 000 000 or even more players? Spread the word and let the masses know that we’ll also have a [b]release sale that will offer a 25% discount[/b] around the release time and some time after!
[b]After that discount, we’ll increase the price a bit to a hellish price point of 6.66 $/€😈[/b]

[h3]Stay Hydrated
- Chasing Carrots 🥕[/h3]




Some Previews ✨ (WIP)

notes.title: HoT Dev Log: Release Progress
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Everyone![/h2]

Since we are fully focusing on bringing out the, if not biggest, at least most important update, you won’t see many updates within the next two months. So, to bridge the waiting time, we wanted to share a few details about the progress towards the full release.

The upcoming update will bring the “Main Story” to an end by adding the last major dungeon for the regular progress path. But we’ll also add some additional features for the late- and end-game.

[h3]A short overview of what we can currently confirm:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stage 6, the Vault
[*] The Scriptor, a new NPC to be rescued from the Frozen Depths
[*] The Shrine of Torment (late and end game challenges)
[*] Artifacts to customize the game experience in the Shrine of Torment
[*] Tier V character traits, new blessings related to critical hits and champion drops
[*] Final item adjustments, variants for all items including a new rarity level
[*] Polishing and QoL features for a better game experience
[/list]

More information will be shared in time, but until then, please enjoy the following screenshots! :)
[i]Note: Everything is still work in progress, visuals and values might still change.[/i]

notes.title: HoT Patch - 2024-07-05
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We have a small update today, mainly to adress broken, untranslated or wrong localizations in the game.
Aside from that we have been also looking in a few issues with the UI.

We also fixed an issue that equipped items might not correctly trigger signals in the game that may be required for quests or other features. Most prominently fixing the issue that item damage was not tracked properly. This could happen to all items and should now work properly.

Stay Fresh!
- Chasing Carrots

notes.title: HoT Fix | 2024-06-20
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Adventurers![/h2]

While we're continuing our work on additional content, we try to keep the current life version of the game in good shape. Multiple players reported a progression blocking issue that would prevent them to unlock certain quest boards. As a result players were unable to unlock the fourth stage or the Cupbearer.

This was an issue connected to playing the Prelude version first and then switching the profile to the full version. This hotfix should solve this rather annoying problem. In case of any persisting issues in that regard, please let us know and we will investigate further.

Have fun!
- Chasing Carrots

tags.bug: This hotfix should solve this rather annoying problem.

notes.title: HoT Fix | 2024-06-17
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Adventurers![/h2]

We've seen some reports in the discussion forums that trait-based quests weren't triggered when the game runs in a different language than English. This was a bug in our quest system that would use the translated trait name to check a condidtion instead of the internally used name.

This problem should be resolved with this hotfix.
We've also received updated versions of translation files from our translation team, which fix some spelling in a couple of languages.

We expect to release a couple more hotfixes in the near future. So, if you encounter any other problems, let us know in the forums and we'll try to fix then as soon as we can.

Godspeed!
- Chasing Carrots

We've also received updated versions of translation files from our translation team, which fix some spelling in a couple of languages.

notes.title: HoT Language Update: 2024-06-13
notes.content:
[h1]Guten Tag, Abenteurer![/h1]

That was German, just one of the newly added languages. From this day onwards Halls of Torment will be available in these languages: [b]Chinese (Simplified), Czech, English, French, German,  Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish,  Portuguese (Portugal & Brazilian), Russian, Spanish (Spain & Latin America), Ukrainian[/b]
The language is selected automatically based on your Steam settings, but you can also change it with the newly added language selection in the game.

We’ll try to be always up-to-date with the translations, but there’s a good chance that some texts may not be localized when updates arrive. Rest assured that these texts will then get proper treatment in the next update. We don’t intend to hold back content if there are only translations missing. In those cases the texts will be displayed in English.

[b]Aside from translations we've worked on some more content and smaller features.[/b]
[list]
[*] Gem Clusters are now colored based on the XP amounts they are giving.
[*] Selecting an inventory slot in the stash menu will now filter the items in the stash.
[*] Three new gloves: Frost Thorns, Thundercharged Gauntlets, Bloodstained Wrappings
[*] New Glove Variants: Sparking Tipps, Invocator’s Grasp, Thornfists, Fencer Gauntlet, Spellcaster Gloves
[*] New Quests & Achievements: Untouchable II (Norseman), Blood’s Blessing (Beast Huntress)
[*] Bug Fixes & Smaller balancing adjustments
[/list]

You can see the current state of all items on the [url=https://hot.fandom.com/wiki/Halls_of_Torment_Wiki]Wiki[/url].
Thanks to GKWS and the rest of our awesome community!


[h2]Complete Change Log[/h2]

[h3]Translations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adding translations for: Chinese (Simplified), Czech, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish,  Portuguese (Portugal & Brazilian), Russian, Spanish (Spain & Latin America), Ukrainian
[*] Automatic language detection based on Steam language settings
[*] Added language selection from the settings menu
[*] Note: Because the game is steadily developing, not all texts will be translated when updates are released. We’ll be updating the translation of new texts as soon as possible.
[/list]


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Electrify” effect is now called “Spark”.
[*] Several various adjustments to the English texts
[*] Quest board was extended to offer more space for text.
[*] Quest Tracker now shows required character
[/list]


[h3]Small Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gem Clusters now change color depending on their XP value.
[*] Blue: <50, Yellow: <500, Red: <5000, Translucent: 5000 or more
[*] Selecting an inventory slot in the stash menu will now filter the items in the stash.
[/list]


[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sparking Tips: Variant (Lightning) has been added
[*] Invocator’s Grasp: Variant (Elites) has been added
[*] Thronfists: Variant (Vacuum) has been added
[*] Fencer Gauntlets: Variant (Multistrike) has been added
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: Variant (Uncommon) has been removed
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: Variant (Hyperfocus) has been added
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: Variant (Multitasking) has been added
[*] New Item: Frost Thorns including two Variants
[*] New Item: Thundercharge Gauntlets including three Variants
[*] New Item: Bloodstained Wrappings including two Variants
[/list]


[h3]Quests[/h3]
[list]
[*] Untouchable II (Norseman) has been added, unlocking Frost Thorns
[*] Blood’s Blessing (Beast Huntress) has been added, unlocking Bloodstained Wrappings
[*] Trained Sorceress (Sorceress) does now unlock Thundercharged Gauntlets
[/list]


[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunting Gloves: 20% -> 30% Multistrike
[*] Hunting Gloves (Boost): 40% -> 60% Multistrike
[*] Hunting Gloves (Growth): 20% -> 30% Multistrike
[*] Hunting Gloves (Growth): 0.5%/2 Levels Multistrike -> 0.3%/Level Multistrike 
[*] Invocator’s Grasp: 40% Spawns -> 30% Spawns, Remove Force
[*] Invocator’s Grasp: 20% Damage -> 50% Damage
[*] Invocator’s Grasp (Uncommon) replaced with variants (Swarm) and (Elites)
[*] Invocator’s Grasp (Swarm): 60% Spawns, 50% Damage
[*] Invocator’s Grasp (Elites): 30% Spawns, 20 Base Damage, 50% Damage
[*] Unholy Touch: 50% Affliction -> 20% Fragile
[*] Unholy Touch (Uncommon): -> (Slow) / 100% Affliction -> 20% Slow
[*] Unholy Touch (Fragile): 100% Fragile -> 40% Fragile
[*] Unholy Touch (all variants): Scale now with their respective effect chances
[*] Sparking Tips (all variants): Projectiles deal now damage based on the targets elemental stacks
[*] Sparking Tips (all variants): Now scale with modifiers
[*] Sparking Tips (all variants): 100% Trigger Chance -> 10% Trigger Chance
[*] Sparking Tips (all variants): Burn Chance bonus
[*] Sparking Tips: 15% Burn Chance -> 20% Burn Chance
[*] Sparking Tips (Uncommon) -> (Fire)
[*] Sparking Tips (Fire): 15% Burn Chance -> 20% Burn Chance
[*] Sparking Tips (Fire): +100% Elemental effect damage bonus
[*] Thornfists (Uncommon) -> (Retribution)
[*] Quickhand Gloves (Growth): 0.4%/Level Attack Speed -> 0.3%/Level Attack Speed
[*] Longfinger Gloves & (Growth): 80% Pickup Range -> 100% Pickup Range
[*] Longfinger Gloves (Boost): 160% Pickup Range -> 200% Pickup Range
[*] Fencer Gauntlets (all variants): Removed additional block strength
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: 66.6% maximum Damage Bonus -> 100%
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: Reduce Delay from 2s to 1s
[*] Spellcaster Gloves: Increase Charge Speed
[*] Trait Piercing Wind: 0.10 Base Crit Bonus -> 0.15 Base Crit Bonus
[*] Iron Ring: 10 Base Damage -> 15 Base Damage
[*] Iron Ring (Boost): 20 Base Damage -> 30 Base Damage
[*] Iron Ring (Growth): 10 Base Damage -> 15, 0.125 Damage per Level -> 0.15
[*] Plated Boots (all variants): Changed % values to base values
[*] Plated Boots: 10 Defense, 10 Block Strength
[*] Plated Boots (Boost): 20 Defense, 20 Block Strength
[*] Plated Boots (Growth): 0.1 Defense & Block Strength per Level
[*] Runner Shoes: 25% Movement Speed -> 20% Movement Speed
[*] Runner Shoes (Boost): 45% Movement Speed -> 40% Movement Speed
[*] Runner Shoes (Growth): 0.5% Movement Speed / 2 Levels -> 0.2%/Level
[*] Plate Armor: 20% Block Strength -> 10 Base Block Strength
[*] Plate Armor: 20% Health -> 25% Health
[*] Plate Armor (Boost): 20 Base Block Strength & 50% Health
[*] Plate Armor (Growth): 0.1 Base Block & 0.25% Health per Level
[*] Chain Mail: 20% Defense -> 10 Base Defense
[*] Chain Mail: 20% Max Health -> 25% Max Health
[*] Chain Mail (Boost): 20 Base Defense & 50% Max Health
[*] Chain Mail (Growth): 0.1 Base Defense & 0.25% Max Health per Level 
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Projectile Stats, the cone display did not give correct information
[*] Exterminator’s Flame Caster no longer scales cone with Area
[*] Added missing Modifier Icons for Vision Crown and Warchief’s Visor
[*] Thunder Crown (Uncommon) had no Crit Chance (now 10%) / Crit Bonus (now 100%)
[*] Thunder Crown (Uncommon) had wrong Base Damage of 100 instead of 200
[*] Thunder Crown (Uncommon) falsely scaled with Attack Speed and Multistrike
[*] Swordsman character info in the selection screen were wrong (Main Weapon stats)
[*] Beast Huntress’ Base multistrike increase should have been 0.006 instead of 0.005 per level
[*] Beast Huntress character info stated 0.01 multistrike increase per level, was fixed
[*] Description of Frost Avalanche IV (Frost) Trait: Frost Chance -> Elemental Effect Chance
[*] Sparking Tips now show up in damage statistics
[*] Red item chests only gave 1 instead 2 item options
[*] Potion chests would display 2 instead of 1 item option
[*] OnHitChance sources are now properly displayed as bonus in Effect Chance on Hit details
[*] Sparking Tips damage now counts as Item, Fire and Projectile damage
[*] Thornfists damage now counts as Item, Melee and Physical damage
[*] Cleric’s Weapon Proficiency (Propagation) was not properly applying its effects
[*] Transfixion Specialist quest had the wrong amount of triggers in the description
[*] Norseman’s Proficient Stance (Blizzard) did not add Frost Chance
[*] Sorceress description falsely stated she has no base regeneration
[*] Ring Blades were not considered “Melee” for Attack Speed
[*] Warlock’s “Bloodletting”-Traits were falsely limited to the main weapon
[*] Abilities get some base crit chances before revisiting their final balancing
[*] Kugelblitz: 0% -> 10% Crit Chance
[*] Dragon’s Breath; 0% -> 5% Crit Chance
[*] Radiant Aura: 0% -> 5% Crit Chance
[*] Golem Melee: 20% -> 10% Crit Chance | 65% -> 100% Crit Bonus
[*] Golem Roll: 0% -> 20% Crit Chance | 100% -> 200% Crit Bonus
[*] Updating all mismatches in the english achievements on Steam
[/list]



Stay Fresh
🥕 Chasing Carrots

notes.title: HoT Experimental Update: 2024-06-07
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Adventurers![/h1]

Our next update is drawing near. In it we will add translations in multiple languages to the game. The experimental update will include a first unrefined batch of translations that will receive some fixes until next week. Alongside the translation we’ve run a full quality pass over the original texts. And finally we’ve also worked on glove items and some smaller changes and bug fixes.

[b]Note: Not all languages are available yet as they are WIP. UIs may not fit yet![/b]
Languages available: Chinese (Simplified), Czech, French, German, Italian, Korean, Polish,  Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, Spanish (Spain & Latin America), Ukrainian
Missing: Japanese, Portuguese (Portugal)

As usual, everyone can join the experimental branch to get an early impression of the update. You can access the branch in Steam via [b]games properties -> betas -> setting the beta participation to experimental[/b]. We are looking forward to your feedback on the Steam Forums or Discord!

[b]Experimental Update: 7th June 2024
Main Update: 14th June 2024[/b]


[h2]Experimental Changelog[/h2]


[h3]Translations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adding translations for: Chinese (Simplified), Czech, French, German, Italian, [strike]Japanese[/strike], Korean, Polish,  Portuguese ([strike]Portugal [/strike]& Brazilian), Russian, Spanish (Spain & Latin America), Ukrainian
[*] Automatic language detection based on Steam language settings
[*] Added language selection from the settings menu
[/list]
[i]Note: Because the game is steadily developing, not all texts will be translated when updates are released. We’ll be updating the translation of new texts as soon as possible.[/i]



[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The “Electrify” effect is now called “Spark”.
[*] Several various adjustments to the English texts
[*] Quest board was extended to offer more space for text.
[*] Quest Tracker now shows required character
[/list]


[h3]Small Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gem Clusters now change color depending on their XP value.
[*] Blue: <50, Yellow: <500, Red: <5000, Translucent: 5000 or more
[*] Selecting an inventory slot in the stash menu will now filter the items in the stash.
[/list]
